status: NOT BUILT. No image described here has been built, booted or installed. These are the build inputs.

components.needs: Python 3.9 or newer, standard library only

security: No listening port: the hub opens every connection itself
A firewall that denies incoming connections
Automatic security updates from the base system
No secret in the image: a hub is enrolled by a person with a one-time code
The hub runs as its own locked user, with a read-only system and one writable directory

profiles.name: HANNAH OS Desktop/Edge
profiles.for: A mini PC or single-board computer that is the household's or office's hub

base.why: Widest hardware and driver support; standard packages; easiest to debug

profiles.name: HANNAH OS Robotics

base.why: ROS 2 Jazzy's supported platform; see robotics/ros2_ws/VERSIONS.yaml

components.needs: Python 3.9 or newer; rclpy for the ROS 2 adapter

notes: Real-time motor control is not on this computer's Linux processes: it belongs to the robot's controller (ros2_control, a microcontroller or the vendor's drive).

profiles.name: HANNAH OS IoT Gateway
profiles.for: A small, unattended box that only runs the hub

base.why: Immutable, made of confined snaps, with transactional updates that roll back by themselves

profiles.name: HANNAH OS Industrial Edge
profiles.for: A gateway on a plant network, between equipment and HANNAH

base.why: As the IoT gateway; a custom image for one board family is the case for a Yocto build instead

notes: Modbus TCP is in the core. OPC UA is not built.
The equipment's network must not be reachable from the internet: the gateway has one interface to the plant network and one outbound route.

profiles.name: HANNAH OS Developer Edition

base.why: As Desktop/Edge, with the tools to build

notes: Includes HANNAH's simulators: python3 -m hannah_edge simulate
